**Advertisement 1: Crowe & Co., Ltd., Basle — International Shipping & Forwarding Agents**
- Bounding box (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max): approximately **[350, 335, 2315, 3140]**
- Content: Framed advertisement headed "International Shipping & Forwarding Agents – Crowe & Co., Ltd., Basle," with branches at Zurich, Chiasso and St. Gall. Lists the firm as General Freight-Agents for Switzerland for the London & North Eastern Railway Company, Great Eastern Train Ferries Limited, Cunard Steam Ship Company Limited, Commonwealth & Dominion Line, and Imperial Airways Limited; and as Agents of the Canadian Pacific Railway and Dominion Express Company of Canada. Also mentions groupage services to Antwerp/U.K./U.S.A./Canada, allied houses in England, Belgium, Italy and Alsace-Lorraine, insurance at lowest premiums, own storage accommodations, and motor car transports.
